ext.name: YDM – Fast Download Manager
ext.description: Faster, safer downloads, right inside your browser. No programs to install.

popup.off: YDM is off: the browser handles your downloads.
popup.hint: YDM takes over files of {size} or more on its own. For anything else: right-click a link → Download with YDM.
popup.addPlaceholder: Paste one or more links, one per line
popup.grabNone: No downloadable links found on this page.
popup.grabBlocked: This page cannot be read by extensions.

reason.noSpaceNeed: not enough disk space ({gb} GB needed)
reason.changed: the file changed on the server during the download
reason.wrongPart: the server sent the wrong part of the file
reason.compressed: the server compresses the file's parts
reason.network: could not connect to the site
reason.forbidden: the site does not accept external downloads ({status})
reason.notFound: file not found or link expired ({status})
reason.program: it is a program: the browser checks it with Safe Browsing
reason.browserRejected: the browser did not accept the file
reason.saveCrash: stopped by the browser, usually by a security check
reason.saveTooLarge: file too large for the disk

settings.title: YDM settings
settings.heading: Settings
settings.enabledHelp: Takes over large downloads from the browser. When off, the browser downloads everything as usual.
settings.minSizeHelp: The browser downloads smaller files: they finish before extra connections would help.
settings.connectionsHelp: Each connection downloads a piece of the file. YDM starts with fewer and adds more only while the speed keeps rising. Browsers allow 6 connections per site in total, shared by every download from that site.
settings.parallelHelp: The others wait in the queue and start as soon as one finishes.
settings.speedLimitHelp: To leave bandwidth for everyone else while you download. Applies to all YDM downloads together, and changes running ones right away.
settings.programsHelp: Files like .exe, .msi and .bat are downloaded by the browser, so Safe Browsing also checks the site they come from. When off, programs download fast too, but the browser sees them coming from YDM and only checks the file.
settings.checksumHelp: Computes each finished file's fingerprint, to compare with the one published by the site. Runs while the file is being saved.
settings.languageHelp: Automatic uses your browser's language, or English if YDM is not translated into it yet.
settings.notifyHelp: A system notification, with a button to show the file.
settings.sitesHelp: The browser always downloads from these sites and their subdomains.
settings.siteInvalid: That is not a site address. Type for example mega.nz or www.example.com.
